description: This file defines React components for displaying and managing attachments in a trace viewer UI, including image diffs, screenshots, and other attachments, with support for lazy loading and expansion.

classes.name: ExpandableAttachment
classes.description: React component for displaying an expandable attachment, supporting lazy loading of text content and download link.

methods.name: attachmentURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for accessing an attachment, either via SHA1 hash or file path.

methods.name: downloadURL
methods.description: Constructs a download URL for an attachment, including content type and name as query parameters.

methods.name: attachmentKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for an attachment based on index and SHA1 or path.
